why: Both analyses land on a credit-guarantee hedgehog, name all four key brutal facts and flag Stages 1-3 plus the thin-capital path to government rescue, but Analysis 2's denominator (income per dollar of credit risk after a capital charge) sits closer to the key's profit per risk level, and its stop-doing list retires the public EPS-doubling goal and the adversarial stance toward regulators more explicitly. Analysis 1 has the tighter one-screen verdict, while Analysis 2 is slightly more careful about marking unknowns such as the accounting black box and the limits of the framework.
